title: Result of lora.trace
description: Companion. When the last LoRa management frames went on the air here and when the last reply frames to its rf.request were heard, against its millisecond clock now, so a lost frame can be placed against its neighbours (LORA_MANAGEMENT.md section 7). Apart from status.get, whose signed result it would outgrow.

now_ms.description: The device's millisecond clock when this was written, to align the times against another device's.

sent.description: The newest frames on the air first: [frame index, millisecond clock when the radio finished sending it].

heard.description: The newest reply frames heard first: [xid, frame index, millisecond clock when heard].
